conventions.s_um: along the w035 outward normal (4 nearest vertices); 0 = trace point; + outward (toward w036)
conventions.on_sheet: level >= 0.5: (I - gap level) / (crest - gap level), gap level = 10th percentile of the line, crest = nearest ridge
conventions.maxima_all: [s_um, intensity, prominence] of every local maximum, no cut
conventions.coords: trace x 8 and mesh rows in level-0 (1.129 um); level-3 index = level-0 / 8

noise.how: 1.4826 x MAD of neighbour differences / sqrt 2, level-3 voxels

cuts_why.noise3: 3 x sqrt(2) x sigma: a ridge's prominence is a difference of two noisy samples (std sigma x sqrt 2), sigma = the larger of the two in-plane voxel noise estimates. A noise-only maximum reaches this in about 0.1% of cases. Main cut: it asks only that a dip is not noise.
cuts_why.noise2: 2 x sqrt(2) x sigma, a lenient version of the same rule.
cuts_why.null_p90: 90th percentile of the prominences of all local maxima on null lines (arc tangent, same length and sampling, through the trace point and through the w035 crossing).
cuts_why.null_p95: 95th percentile of the same null. Kept as an upper, conservative cut: the cross-sections show the tangent lines do cross thin sheets (sheets here are wavy and bundled), so this null contains real sheet edges and overstates noise.
